verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills/plugin framework that augments existing coding agents, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence only documents installation through harness plugin mechanisms (Claude Code marketplace, Devin CLI, Hermes, Antigravity, npx skills) and a 'Skills-search tool'. None of it shows Superpowers exposing an official MCP server endpoint or an 'mcp serve' mode.
